description: crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs: JmapHandler::call signature takes 'method: String' and 'call_id: String' by value. Every handler implementation receives these owned strings but most just ignore them or pass them into an async block. At the dispatch site (lib.rs:170-173) method_clone and call_id_clone are cloned specifically to pass by value into the spawned task. Using &str would avoid the allocations for handlers that do not need ownership; those that do (e.g. EchoHandler) can call .to_owned() inside. However: because the return type is a Pin<Box<Future + Send + 'static>>, the handler cannot borrow from the call — the future must own its data. So String is correct for the args and caller, but method and call_id could be passed as String only to handlers that actually capture them. This is a real tradeoff; the current design opts for simplicity at the cost of one clone per dispatch. Flag as a considered tradeoff that should be documented, not necessarily changed.
title: JmapHandler::call takes method/call_id by String not &str
